source: User-supplied Wave Race 64 USA revision 1 ROM on VENGEANCE
method: Four standalone mono PCM loop assets decoded from bank0 ADPCM samples. Original loop starts/ends and instrument0/1/2 zone tunings are retained in manifest.json. Sequence0's layers select base instrument0 at velocity117 and a water/dry layer using channel program1/2 with independently controlled velocity.
tools: Existing REA/Ghidra analysis on EVO X2
mix: Original sample PCM and loop boundaries. Web Audio pitch smoothing, short crossfades for sample-zone changes, attack/release smoothing and bus gain approximate the original audio engine; not bit-exact N64 RSP output. This asset/playback checkpoint does not yet replace the live game's engine owner.
